# Yash Verma

> Personal portfolio for Yash Verma, a cloud and automation engineer building GitHub-Actions-native Discord widgets, real-time data pipelines, browser-native interfaces, and constraint-first systems on free infrastructure.

- Canonical site: https://meyashverma.github.io/yashverma-dev/
- GitHub: https://github.com/MeYashverma
- Primary areas: automation, GitHub Actions, Python, JavaScript, Node.js, APIs, cloud, cybersecurity, design, and digital art.
- Highlighted work: AetherOS, Lyrically, Vinyl.fm, Waifu Widget, Genshin Stats, and LaunchPad.
- Repo Radar is a self-updating project section rendered from the public GitHub API (plus a daily Actions-built snapshot); it automatically lists every public repo not already showcased on the page, including working forks.
- Developer Pulse shows the GitHub contribution heatmap for the last 12 months with client-computed streaks, plus optional WakaTime coding-stats telemetry provided by a daily Actions-built snapshot.
- The site has a runtime theme system (Chroma Engine) with five accent themes and a Konami-code "overdrive" easter egg.
- Daily equipment includes an HP EliteBook 8 G1a laptop and an OPPO K13 Turbo Pro 5G phone.
- Build Notes is a short, maintained field-notes section about engineering constraints and decisions; it is not a formal blog.

For the most accurate current work and contact links, use the canonical site or GitHub profile above.
